title: Nebulized Colistin for Hospital-Acquired Pneumonia
brief_summary: Nebulized Colistin for Adjunctive Therapy of Hospital-Acquired Pneumonia caused by Gram Negative Bacteria should be more effective than conventional therapy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult (age\>18 years) hospitalized patient with hospital-acquired pneumonia due to Gram negative bacteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* lactating woman
* colistin allergy
* severe renal impairment
* epilepsy
